description: This file defines the Cobalt extension graphics API, including structures and function pointers for managing graphics rendering, post-processing, and 360 video support.

methods.name: GetMaximumFrameIntervalInMilliseconds
methods.description: Function pointer to retrieve the maximum frame interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: GetMinimumFrameIntervalInMilliseconds
methods.description: Function pointer to retrieve the minimum frame interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: IsMapToMeshEnabled
methods.description: Function pointer to check if 360 degree video support is enabled.

methods.name: ShouldClearFrameOnShutdown
methods.description: Function pointer to determine if the framebuffer should be cleared on shutdown and to specify the clear color.

methods.name: GetMapToMeshColorAdjustments
methods.description: Function pointer to get color adjustments for 360 videos.

methods.name: GetRenderRootTransform
methods.description: Function pointer to insert a custom transform at the root of rendering.

methods.name: ReportFullyDrawn
methods.description: Function pointer called when the web app reports it should be drawn.
